# IBLens

> IBLens is an independent AI feedback tool for IB (International Baccalaureate) coursework. It grades drafts of coursework in 14 subjects (the Internal Assessment in eleven, plus the externally assessed coursework in Visual Arts, Music and Film), the Extended Essay (both the current 34-mark rubric and the new 30-mark May 2027 rubric), the TOK essay and the TOK exhibition against the published assessment criteria. One free preview per device or account; a full report (criterion by criterion, the TOK essay and exhibition as a whole) is $9.99, with no subscription. Not affiliated with the IBO. Scores are AI estimates, not guarantees.

## Product

- [Essay Grader](https://iblens.com/essay): paste a draft, pick work type, subject and exam session, get criterion-level feedback
- [UCAS Personal Statement Checker](https://iblens.com/ucas-personal-statement): the three-question format from 2026 entry, with character checks and feedback on each answer
- [IB Remark Check](https://iblens.com/remark): whether an enquiry upon results is worth it, with deadlines for both sessions
- [How IBLens Works](https://iblens.com/resources/how-iblens-works): the grading pipeline explained
- [Sample Reports](https://iblens.com/resources/sample-reports): three TOK essays at three quality levels, each with its unedited report
- [Pricing](https://iblens.com/pricing): free preview, $9.99 full report, packs of five and ten, no subscription
- [About](https://iblens.com/about): where IBLens came from, how the grader works and what it will not do

## May 2027 syllabus changes

- [EE New Criteria 2027](https://iblens.com/resources/ib-extended-essay-new-criteria-2027): the 30-mark rubric, Framework 6, Knowledge 6, Analysis 6, Discussion and evaluation 8, Reflection 4
- [EE RPF 2027](https://iblens.com/resources/ib-rpf-extended-essay-2027): the 500-word reflective statement replacing the RPPF
- [Psychology IA 2027](https://iblens.com/resources/ib-psychology-ia-2027): research proposal marked /24, no experiment conducted
- [Computer Science IA 2027](https://iblens.com/resources/ib-computer-science-ia-2027): computational solution marked /30, client requirement removed

## Guides

- [IB IA Feedback](https://iblens.com/resources/ib-ia-feedback): marks by subject and the heaviest criteria
- [EE Feedback Channels](https://iblens.com/resources/ib-extended-essay-feedback): supervisor rules and self-check sequence
- [TOK Essay Checklist](https://iblens.com/resources/tok-essay-checklist): the holistic /10 instrument and five bands
- [TOK Exhibition Checklist](https://iblens.com/resources/tok-exhibition-checklist): one prompt, three objects, justification
- [AI Coursework Review Tools Compared](https://iblens.com/resources/ib-coursework-review-tools): honest comparison, checked August and September 2026
- [IB Grade Boundaries](https://iblens.com/resources/ib-grade-boundaries): how subject grades combine into the Diploma score
